note: Descriptions and captions of the photos in images/, kept by Artiscope Digital Home.

grove-gallery-23-7-26-018402.jpg.alt: A square artwork in collage and paint. A large glossy black disc with the name Konn Artiss in white capital letters sits over torn printed paper and thick strokes of yellow, red, black and pale peach paint.

banksy-statue-waterloo-place.jpg.alt: A dark statue seen from below against a grey sky: a man in a suit strides off the edge of a stone plinth while a large flag he holds blows back over his face, with scaffolded buildings behind.
banksy-statue-waterloo-place.jpg.caption: Statue by Banksy in Waterloo Place, London, installed in April 2026. Photographed in May 2026. Photo: Bex Walton, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Banksy_statue,_Waterloo_Place,_2026-05-04.jpg

yayoi-kusama-c2004.jpg.alt: Close view of Yayoi Kusama's face, with dark hair, red lipstick and pale pink glasses in a decorative silver frame.
yayoi-kusama-c2004.jpg.caption: Yayoi Kusama, around 2004. A still from George Quasha's film series art is (Speaking Portraits). Photo: George Quasha, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Yayoi_Kusama_circa_2004.jpg

el-anatsui-ambivalent-hold-nsukka.jpg.alt: A weathered grey stone sculpture of a crouching, rounded figure whose large hands cover its face, set on paving in front of a yellow concrete building.
el-anatsui-ambivalent-hold-nsukka.jpg.caption: Ambivalent Hold, from a design by El Anatsui, made by the SKEP art collective for the Physical Sciences building at the University of Nigeria, Nsukka. Photographed in 2024. Photo: Mercyjamb123, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:El_Anatsui,_Ambivalent_Hold,_at_the_physical_science_building_in_university_of_Nsukka.jpg

s-h-raza-delhi-2011.jpg.alt: S.H. Raza, an elderly man with white hair and glasses in a pale suit, seated and leaning over a sheet of paper as people gather close around him.
s-h-raza-delhi-2011.jpg.caption: S.H. Raza at an art summit in Delhi, January 2011. Photo: Chetan Nikam, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:SH_Raza_1.JPG

gerhard-richter-prague-2017.jpg.alt: Portrait of Gerhard Richter, an older man with white hair, a short white beard and round dark glasses, in a dark coat, looking at the camera.
gerhard-richter-prague-2017.jpg.caption: Gerhard Richter at the National Gallery, Prague, in April 2017. Photo: Jindřich Nosek (NoJin), CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gerhard_Richter_(2017).jpg
